description: From 30 days of half-hour radar records (ix_hist): the share of consecutive records that differ, samples per change and how often a radar jumps 5+ points and straight back within an hour. Above 0.5 the radar changes between records (below the Nyquist rate): do not read one half-hour move as a trend. Rule-based, no AI. In honour of Harry Nyquist (1889-1976), 'Certain Topics in Telegraph Transmission Theory' (1928).
name: get_nyquist
title: Nyquist sensor: is each radar recorded often enough for how fast it changes
